group.description: Which taxonomy the category belongs to. Carried explicitly rather than derived from a name prefix, so that regrouping a category is a visible contract change.

detector.description: Which detector produced this finding, and at which version. Required on every finding: it is what makes `certainty` auditable, and what lets a detector upgrade invalidate cached results (§14.1).

message.description: Plain-language statement of what was found. Must not contain the unmasked detected value, and must not assert certainty the finding does not have: a probabilistic finding is phrased as a candidate, never as a fact (§7.3).
